subject: sampling from custom functions in pystan?

messages.author: 05a98452bfc1172d
messages.subject: sampling from custom functions in pystan?
parts: Is there any way to use pystan to sample from custom functions that are not part of the standard distributions?

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: sampling from custom functions in pystan?
parts:
There is an optional functions block that can be put at the top of your .stan file where you can write any custom distributions you need and then use them like Stan's distributions (in terms of how you use them in your model code). The section in the manual about user defined functions will get you started.

Jonah
